_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); premium revenue, medical care ratio, fee revenue, operating cost ratio and operating margin signals with UnitedHealth Group's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'UnitedHealth Group is a diversified health and well-being company, serving more than 70 million Americans.' 'If we fail to effectively estimate, price for and manage our health care costs, the profitability of our risk-based products could decline and could materially adversely affect our future financial results.' 'In total, management believes that economic recessions will slow our revenue growth rate and could impact our operating profitability.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

'In total, management believes that economic recessions will slow our revenue growth rate and could impact our operating profitability.'; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a health benefits company on this date (OFFSHORE is scoped to IT services), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.22x; -21% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.12; conservative 2yr +61%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -15.7%/yr (worst year FY99-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.0%/yr (FY10 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +23.4%/yr (FY99-FY09 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +38.8%/yr (best 2-yr run FY99-FY09, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNH (retrospective, 2010-01-29) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.22x (43.8% downside to Bear $18.53 / +195.0% upside to Bull $97.34) | Adj composite 2.65 vs market 1.53: gap +1.12 [UNDERVALUED] | -21% above the EPP floor $42.00 (14x FY10E $3.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +61.1% total (+30.5%/yr) | At 11.0x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $43.64 sits at or below the BASE case; revenue +6.5% YoY in Q4 2009, forward revenues +1.6-2.7% (FY10 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
